scope: Requests arriving at a Polish city office (reference: Urzad Miasta Bydgoszczy) that may or may not be access-to-public-information (UDIP) requests. Derived from research/02-udip-law-process-taxonomy.md sections 2-4.

legal_status.udip: ustawa z 6.09.2001 o dostepie do informacji publicznej, t.j. Dz.U. 2022 poz. 902, amended by Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1844 (art. 10 ust. 1, in force 1.07.2026)
legal_status.reuse_act: ustawa z 11.08.2021 o otwartych danych i ponownym wykorzystywaniu informacji sektora publicznego, t.j. Dz.U. 2023 poz. 1524
legal_status.kpa: Kodeks postepowania administracyjnego, t.j. Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1691
legal_status.note: Evidence labels (V/S/U) of every rule are in the research report. Rules marked evidence=U must be checked by a lawyer before being hard-coded as automatic behaviour.

clock.day_zero: Day the request reaches the office through any channel (EZD registration timestamp).
clock.D14: Filing date + 14 calendar days (UDIP art. 13 ust. 1). Show the conservative date without weekend or holiday shifting.
clock.D60: Filing date + 2 months (UDIP art. 13 ust. 2). Extension notice must be sent inside D14 with concrete reasons and a new date not later than D60.
clock.applicant_reply_14: 14 days given to the applicant after an art. 14 ust. 2 notice or an art. 15 fee notice.
clock.formal_defect_7: At least 7 days to remedy a formal defect (KPA art. 64 par. 2; re-use act art. 39 ust. 5).
clock.appeal_14: Appeal to SKO within 14 days of service of a decision (KPA art. 129 par. 2); the appeal body decides within 14 days (UDIP art. 16 ust. 2).
clock.court_files_15: Office sends court complaint files and its answer within 15 days (UDIP art. 21 pkt 1).

applicant_identification.description: State attached to every case. UDIP sets no formal requirements, but the newer NSA line (III OSK 1602/24, III OSK 2396/25) lets the office clarify who the applicant is when the sender cannot be identified, and a decision always needs a party and a signature.

states.meaning: Name and a deliverable address or e-mail known; signature or qualified channel (ePUAP, login.gov.pl, e-Dorecz.) present.
E-mail address or alias only, or name without signature. Enough for a plain letter in the classic line.
No usable identity. Never auto-reject. Office policy decides: answer anyway (I OSK 1277/08, I OSK 692/18) or call for identification (III OSK 1602/24, III OSK 2396/25).
Call T9 or a policy clarification letter sent; waiting for a reply.
Call expired. Handling depends on office policy and a lawyer; for a planned decision the request is left without consideration (KPA art. 64 par. 2).

rules: Assistant flags applicant_identified=false and shows both case-law lines; it never rejects.
If the planned outcome is a decision (T10, T11), stop the draft and propose T9 first until name, address and signature are on file.
Plain-letter outcomes (T1-T8, T12) go to the address given; no identity beyond a delivery channel is required in the classic line.
Mass-sender indicators (same sender, volume, near-duplicate text) are displayed to a lawyer only; no automatic label of abuse.

approval_roles.clerk: Referent prowadzacy sprawe (UDIP desk or substantive department)
approval_roles.department_head: Kierownik komorki merytorycznej holding the information
approval_roles.signatory: Prezydent Miasta or a person authorised in writing to issue decisions (upowaznienie)
approval_roles.finance: Skarbnik / finance unit, for fee calculation

response_document_types.name_pl: Pismo: wskazanie BIP, portalu danych, CRU JSFP
Wezwanie do wykazania szczegolnie istotnego interesu publicznego
Zawiadomienie art. 14 ust. 2 (forma lub sposob niemozliwy)
Wezwanie do uzupelnienia brakow przed decyzja

request_classes.name: Request for public information under UDIP

subclasses.name: Simple public information held by the office
typical_evidence: department reply with the document or data
art. 12 metadata block (entity, author, releasing person, date)
subclasses.notes: Never ask about purpose (art. 2 ust. 2). Release in the form and manner requested (art. 14 ust. 1).

subclasses.name: Information already available in BIP, portal danych or CRU JSFP
subclasses.legal_route: UDIP art. 10 ust. 1 (text in force since 1.07.2026 includes CRU JSFP)
typical_evidence: exact BIP deep link and navigation path
subclasses.notes: A general 'see BIP' is treated as inaction. Contract content, annexes and pre-1.07.2026 contracts remain ordinary UDIP requests.

subclasses.name: Content is not public information
Legal advice, opinion, explanation of why, creation of a new opinion
Purely private matter of a person
Dokument wewnetrzny (working material, draft, internal note)
subclasses.risk: High risk of inaction complaint; courts apply the doctrine narrowly (I OSK 2130/11). Documents that were a basis of a decision are public.

subclasses.name: Facts or plans not yet recorded

subclasses.deadline_rule: D14 (a plain letter must still arrive within 14 days)
typical_evidence: content analysis against art. 1 and the art. 6 catalogue
subclasses.notes: Plain letter, not a decision (Bydgoszcz BIP card). Partly public content: release that part (T1).

subclasses.name: Office does not hold the information
typical_evidence: written confirmation from every department asked
subclasses.notes: No duty to forward (art. 65 KPA does not apply; evidence=U). Indicating who may hold it is courtesy. Partly held: release the part held.

subclasses.name: Separate access regime applies
typical_evidence: indication of the special act and the competent unit
subclasses.notes: Check that the other act really regulates access comprehensively. See classes KPA_FILES, ENVIRONMENT, ARCHIVE, CIVIL_REGISTERS.

subclasses.name: Processed information (informacja przetworzona)
subclasses.sequence: T6 (usually together with T5) within D14, then T1 if interest is shown or T10 if not.
subclasses.deadline_rule: T6 and T5 by D14; final act by the extended date, not later than D60
typical_evidence: department estimate of operations, sources, files, staff time
assessment of whether the interest is special
subclasses.notes: No statutory procedure; court-made (I OSK 977/11, I OSK 1347/05). The wezwanie is not a formal-defect call: silence needs a decision.

subclasses.name: Art. 5 restriction covers all of the information
restriction_grounds: art. 5 ust. 1 classified information or other statutory secret
art. 5 ust. 2 privacy of a natural person
subclasses.deadline_rule: D14, or the extended date, not later than D60
typical_evidence: confidentiality clause and formal plus material test of the trade secret
list of persons who took a position (art. 16 ust. 2 pkt 2)
subclasses.notes: Privacy does not cover persons performing public functions in connection with the function. Applicant must be identified before the decision (T9 first if not).

subclasses.name: Art. 5 restriction covers a part
subclasses.sequence: Release the anonymised document (T1) and issue T10 for the removed scope. A different line accepts routine anonymisation of private persons' data without a decision when the applicant did not ask for them (evidence=U); office policy decides, assistant flags every redaction.
subclasses.deadline_rule: D14, or the extended date, not later than D60
typical_evidence: redaction log with ground per passage
list of persons who took a position
subclasses.notes: Anonymisation is not processing unless the scale makes it a major project.

subclasses.name: Requested form or manner cannot be used
subclasses.sequence: T8 by D14; if the applicant files a new request within 14 days, T1; otherwise T11 after the 14 days.
subclasses.deadline_rule: T8 by D14, then 14 days for the applicant
subclasses.notes: Only technical means count, not convenience. Withdrawal by the applicant needs no decision.

subclasses.name: Additional costs caused by the requested manner or conversion
subclasses.deadline_rule: T7 by D14; release after 14 days from the notice unless the applicant changes or withdraws the request
typical_evidence: cost calculation: media, copies, postage, conversion
subclasses.notes: No charge for staff time or for searching.

subclasses.name: Cannot be completed in 14 days
subclasses.deadline_rule: T5 by D14; new date not later than D60; no second extension
typical_evidence: concrete reasons (volume, archive retrieval, consultation of third parties)
subclasses.notes: Generic reasons such as workload are criticised; a late notice does not cure inaction.

subclasses.name: Sender not identifiable
subclasses.legal_route: Case law (III OSK 1602/24, III OSK 2396/25); KPA art. 64 par. 2 when a decision is planned
subclasses.deadline_rule: Call as early as possible, at least 7 days to reply; D14 keeps running for plain answers
typical_evidence: policy of the office on anonymous requests

subclasses.name: Indicators of abuse of the right to information
subclasses.legal_route: Case law (I OSK 1601/15, I OSK 2642/16); form of reaction disputed (letter versus decision)
subclasses.notes: The assistant only displays indicators; the label and the reaction are decided by a lawyer.

request_classes.name: Request for re-use of public sector information
triggers: declared commercial purpose or product or service
request for a data feed, API or real-time access (art. 39 ust. 2)
response_document: information that information is not held
request_classes.response_document_note: Own document types, not covered by T1-T12 skeletons; art. 41. Applicant has 14 days to accept or file sprzeciw.
request_classes.deadline_rule: D14 from receipt; extension to 2 months from filing (art. 40). Formal defects: call to remedy within 7 days (art. 39 ust. 5).
request_classes.notes: Appeal body named in art. 43 ust. 1 is the minister for digital affairs; interaction with SKO for local government not checked (open question). A request merely for a document is UDIP even when the sender is a company.

request_classes.name: Party asks for access to files of its own case
request_classes.deadline_rule: D14 for the routing letter; KPA deadlines in the regime
request_classes.notes: Refusal in that regime is a postanowienie, not a UDIP decision.

request_classes.name: Skarga or wniosek (complaint or motion)
request_classes.deadline_rule: 1 month in the complaints regime; route to complaints unit within D14

request_classes.name: Petycja
request_classes.deadline_rule: 3 months in the petition regime; route to petitions unit

request_classes.name: Request for environmental information
request_classes.legal_route: Ustawa z 3.10.2008 o udostepnianiu informacji o srodowisku, dzial II
request_classes.deadline_rule: 1 month, up to 2 months in that regime; keep D14 for the routing letter if handled by UDIP desk
typical_evidence: subject of the request: emissions, tree felling, environmental decisions
request_classes.notes: Evidence=U; check act title and deadlines before relying on them.

request_classes.name: Historical records at the state archive
request_classes.legal_route: Ustawa o narodowym zasobie archiwalnym i archiwach
typical_evidence: transfer record to the Archiwum Panstwowe

request_classes.name: Certificate, civil status record or registered-address data
request_classes.legal_route: Sector acts (akty stanu cywilnego, ewidencja ludnosci, KPA art. 217 zaswiadczenia)
request_classes.deadline_rule: Sector deadlines; D14 for the routing letter

request_classes.name: Press inquiry
request_classes.legal_route: Prawo prasowe art. 3a refers to UDIP; handle as UDIP for public information
request_classes.notes: Evidence=U for the exact press-law mechanics. The journalist gets no privilege and no worse treatment; processed-information test may still apply but the interest is usually shown.

request_classes.name: Request for a whole prosecutor's or court case file
request_classes.legal_route: NSA resolution I OPS 7/13 of 9.12.2013 (not a UDIP request)

request_classes.name: Request with several items of different classes
request_classes.deadline_rule: One clock D14; art. 13 ust. 2 used once for items that need more time; partial release does not wait for the disputed part
request_classes.notes: Split first, classify each item, then merge outputs.

request_classes.name: Cannot be classified with confidence
request_classes.notes: Fallback: route to a human at once, never guess.

decision_tree.action: Register the incoming item, compute D14 and D60
Is it a UDIP request at all
Already in BIP, portal danych or CRU JSFP
Close: log what was sent, to whom, by whom, when

hard_rules: The assistant drafts and cites; it never sends, signs or decides.
Every decision document (T10, T11) requires a named lawyer review and an authorised signatory.
Every art. 5 redaction and every 'not public information' or 'processed' classification is shown to a human with reasons.
Confidence below the configured threshold produces OTHER_UNCLEAR.
Audit trail records who took a position (UDIP art. 16 ust. 2 pkt 2).
